programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável: está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: Suspeita De Traição
programme.desc: Uma advogada está a construir um caso contra um homem suspeito de ser um “serial-killer”. Apesar de ignorar as ameaças de morte que recebe, tudo muda quando o marido desaparece, ela é chantageada e acaba por pedir ajuda ao ex-marido, um detetive de homicídios com a carreira suspensa.

programme.title: Marnie
programme.desc: Uma jovem cleptomaníaca usa identidades falsas para roubar empresas. Quando o patrão descobre a fraude, força-a ao casamento — e tenta desvendar o trauma profundo que ela esconde e que a domina desde criança.

programme.title: All Styles - Ao Ritmo Da Dança
programme.desc: Um jovem adepto do hip-hop é rejeitado pela antiga equipa de dança por ir para a faculdade antes de uma competição importante. Como resultado, ele junta um grupo heterogéneo de dançarinos para enfrentar o seu antigo grupo e ganhar 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: As Aventuras De Lia
programme.desc: Lia é uma órfã jovem e perspicaz que vive nas ruas da Cidade da Névoa. Um belo dia, disfarça-se de princesa e acaba por embarcar numa delirante missão de salvamento de Rolando, o herdeiro do trono que foi enfeitiçado e transformado num... galigato (metade galinha, metade gato).

programme.title: Sete Noivas Para Sete Irmãos
programme.desc: No Oregon de 1850, Adam Pontipee, um rude lenhador, casa com a jovem Milly e leva-a para a quinta onde vivem os seus seis irmãos, de modos muito selvagens, que também decidem casar mas que, inspirados pelo rapto das Sabinas, acabam por raptar seis raparigas da cidade.

programme.title: Mune - O Guardião Da Lua
programme.desc: Num mundo mítico, Mune surpreende toda a gente ao ser nomeado guardião da lua, com a missão de trazer a noite e tomar conta do mundo dos sonhos. Mas uma série de desastres dá a oportunidade ao guardião da escuridão, de roubar o sol. Conseguirá Mune resolver a situação?

programme.title: Ivanhoe
programme.desc: Regressado das Cruzadas, o cavaleiro Ivanhoe luta para resgatar o rei Ricardo Coração de Leão e travar a tirania do príncipe João, entre torneios, traições e um amor impossível, numa grande epopeia medieval de honra e coragem.

programme.title: Bigfoot Júnior
programme.desc: Adam, um rapaz de 13 anos, embarca numa épica aventura para descobrir o mistério que envolve o seu pai, desaparecido desde sempre. Ao chegar à floresta, todos os animais o reconhecem como filho do lendário Bigfoot, pelo seu cabelo fora do normal e pés com vida própria que saltam dos sapatos.

programme.title: Missão Inesperada
programme.desc: Jim Hanson, um ex-atirador de elite do exército, vive junto à isolada fronteira entre os EUA e o México e torna-se inesperadamente o protetor de um menino mexicano, quando um perigoso cartel de droga mata a mãe do rapaz e os começa a perseguir de forma implacável.

programme.title: After
programme.desc: Tessa, uma rapariga bem-comportada de dezoito anos, conhece na faculdade Hardin, um rapaz rude e rico com um passado sombrio, por quem se apaixona e com o qual perde a virgindade. Os dois embarcam numa relação turbulenta e intensa, que os mudará para sempre.

programme.title: Eliminators: Fugir Ou Morrer
programme.desc: Um antigo agente federal tem de abandonar o programa de proteção de testemunhas quando a sua casa é invadida por engano. Quando volta a ser perseguido por um perigoso assassino, tem de fugir com a filha e garantir a sua segurança antes de ser apanhado!

programme.title: Ascensão De Júpiter
programme.desc: Jupiter Jones é uma jovem empregada de limpeza que encontra um dia Caine, um ex-militar interplanetário geneticamente manipulado, e descobre que ela é a herdeira de uma família da nobreza intergalactica e que tem de proteger os habitantes da Terra de uma ameaça antiga e destrutiva.

programme.title: Tudo Bons Rapazes
programme.desc: Desde que era miúdo, nos anos 50, que Henry Hill queria ser um gangster. Ao longo das décadas seguintes, ele conseguiu cumprir o seu sonho e fazer parte de uma das mais importantes famílias criminosas de Nova Iorque. Só que o preço a pagar seria demasiado alto.

programme.title: Traficados
programme.desc: Trazido para Los Angeles para fazer um tratamento, um viciado em recuperação descobre rapidamente que o centro de reabilitação não serve apenas para ajudar pessoas, mas é uma operação fraudulenta multimilionária que recruta viciados que recrutem outros viciados.

programme.title: Cheios De Raiva
programme.desc: Três histórias cruzadas em Los Angeles, com as armas a entrarem na vida de nove pessoas, por vezes de forma fatal.

programme.title: Nós Que Ficámos
programme.desc: A vida pacata de Cami e da sua filha adolescente é virada do avesso com o falecimento repentino do pai da rapariga, cuja nova mulher e filha pequena ficam de repente sem lar nem rendimentos. Cami acolhe-as em sua casa só que não vai ser fácil juntar aquelas quatro figuras debaixo do mesmo teto.

programme.title: The Boy A Maldição De Brahms
programme.desc: Um jovem casal muda-se para a mansão Heelshire, sem nada conhecer da trágica história daquele lugar. Rapidamente, o filho descobre Brahms, um boneco de porcelana que se torna o seu novo melhor amigo… E que vai aterrorizar as suas vidas…

programme.title: Intriga Internacional
programme.desc: Roger O. Thornhill é um executivo publicitário que é confundido com um agente federal por um grupo de espiões. O equívoco dá lugar a uma série de mal-entendidos, incluindo a acusação de homicídio, tentativas de rapto e perseguições, quer por parte dos espiões, quer por parte do governo.

programme.title: Turuleca A Grande Aventura
programme.desc: Turuleca é uma galinha muito especial. O seu peculiar aspeto e a sua incapacidade para pôr ovos são alvo de troça do resto do galinheiro mas o seu talento musical transforma-a numa fascinante estrela do Circo Daedalus.

programme.title: Uma Vontade Cega
programme.desc: Saliya é um jovem promissor que ficou praticamente cego na adolescência mas consegue manter em segredo essa condição num estágio num hotel de luxo. Com determinação e impressionante resiliência, ele supera todas as expectativas e ultrapassa a sua limitação, com a ajuda do seu amigo Max.

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Em 1927, a visita do Rei e da Rainha de Inglaterra à casa da família Crawley, vai lançar a confusão na propriedade de Downton Abbey, tanto entre os nobres como na criadagem.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: Uma Nova Era
programme.desc: Os aristocratas da família Crawley deixam Downton Abbey e partem em viagem ao sul de França para descobrir o mistério da “villa” herdada pela Condessa de Grantham.

programme.title: Extremamente Perverso, Escandalosamente Cruel E Vil
programme.desc: Ted é um homem bonito, inteligente e afetuoso. Liz é uma mãe solteira, cautelosa, mas apaixonada. Imagem da felicidade doméstica, a vida deste casal parece perfeita até ele ser preso e acusado de vários assassínios tenebrosos. Ele é Ted Bundy e torna-se o serial-killer mais famoso da América.

programme.title: Mile 22
programme.desc: Uma pequena equipa de elite de oficiais americanos, parte de uma unidade operações especiais e secretas, tem por missão levar para fora da Indonésia um misterioso agente da polícia com informações sensíveis.

programme.title: O Meu Espião
programme.desc: JJ é um experiente agente da CIA, que, depois de uma missão infiltrado, se vê despromovido e controlado por Sophie, uma miúda de nove anos que lhe descobriu o disfarce e o convenceu a ensiná-la a ser uma espia em troca de não o revelar.

programme.title: Homefront - A Última Defesa
programme.desc: Um ex-agente do departamento de combate à droga muda-se com a filha para uma pequena cidade rural em busca de uma vida tranquila. Quando um conflito escolar expõe o seu passado, ~ele atrai a atenção de um perigoso traficante local que ameaça a sua família.

programme.title: Hell Or High Water - Custe O Que Custar!
programme.desc: Um pai divorciado e seu irmão mais velho, um ex-condenado, recorrem a um plano desesperado de assalto a bancos para salvar a fazenda da sua família no Oeste do Texas.

programme.title: Sin City: Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: Os Ingleses Estão A Chegar
programme.desc: Harriet e Peter Fox são um casal de vigaristas ingleses que, após perderem uma grande soma ao póquer e ficarem a dever dinheiro a uma gangster psicótica, fogem para Los Angeles onde acabam por criar um elaborado plano para roubar um anel à rica ex-mulher de Peter.

programme.title: Sodade
programme.desc: Na Ilha do Fogo, em Cabo Verde, Kevin e Linda são dois jovens amantes que vão ver a sua relação posta à prova não só pela diferença de personalidades mas principalmente por um antigo e sombrio segredo familiar.

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Em 1927, a visita do Rei e da Rainha de Inglaterra à casa da família Crawley, vai lançar a confusão na propriedade de Downton Abbey, tanto entre os nobres como na criadagem.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: Uma Nova Era
programme.desc: Os aristocratas da família Crawley deixam Downton Abbey e partem em viagem ao sul de França para descobrir o mistério da “villa” herdada pela Condessa de Grantham.

programme.title: Vencer A Qualquer Preço
programme.desc: Um jornalista irlandês da área desportiva tem a forte suspeita de que as prestações do ciclista Lance Armstrong nas vitórias da Volta à França foram conseguidas à base de substâncias proibidas, o que o leva a procurar pistas que hão de revelar toda a verdade sobre o atleta.

programme.title: Wagner - Das Rheingold
programme.desc: Hartmut Haenchen conducts the Netherlands Philharmonic Orchestra and Dutch National Opera in a production of Richard Wagner's opera Das Rheingold, the first opera of the four-part cycle 'Der Ring des Nibelungen'. Richard Wagner, perhaps the greatest innovator of the opera genre in the nineteenth century, aimed for the creation of a ‘Gesamtkunstwerk’ in which theatre, music and words are united.

programme.title: Works by Mozart and Sarti
programme.desc: Italian conductor Mattia Rondelli conducts the Orchestra dell’Opera Carlo Felice Genova in a concert program consisting of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Giuseppe Sarti. Soprano Barbara Massaro is the soloist. On the program are Mozart’s Symphony No. 5 in B-flat major, K.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff adored Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 and offered the composer a large sum to write a similar work. Beethoven obliged and completed his Symphony No. 4 in the autumn of 1806.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 And 111
programme.desc: Beethoven’s last three sonatas – Opus 109, 110 and 111 – explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. At the time of their composition, Beethoven was already locked in himself by his deafness. This deeply affected his relationship to others and to the world.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: On November 14, 1987, a promising conductor made his Berlin Philharmonic debut with Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 6: Simon Rattle. In retrospect Rattle says, “I felt that I was finding my voice on that day.” Mahler’s multifaceted work is now again on the program when Sir Simon appears for the last time as chief conductor of the Berliner Philharmoniker in the Philharmonie in 2018. The wheel comes full circle. Mahler's Symphony No.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and others
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of ‘Preludio’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. The program opens with Joseph Haydn’s Concerto in D major for cello and orchestra, H VIIb: 2 (cello and piano reduction), performed by cellist Alejandro Gómez Pareja and pianist Miguel Ángel Ortega Chavaldas.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills.

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the 'Symphony of a Thousand,' is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. The work is a unique and grandiose tribute to love and the spiritual salvation of mankind, drawing from two distinct textual sources to create its sublime effect.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, “Titan”. Composed between 1887 and 1888, the symphony blends traditional form with innovative ideas like folk melodies, march rhythms, and fanfare motifs.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2, Op. 36
programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt leads the Lucerne Festival Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration III
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures!

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century.

programme.title: Brahms Tragic Overture And Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 4, composed between 1899 and 1901, depicts a child's vision of heaven, a theme central to the work's innocent and lyrical character. The symphony is notable for its relatively smaller orchestral forces compared to his other symphonies and its focus on melody and a sense of wonder. The final movement features a soprano solo singing about the joys of heaven, providing a serene and optimistic conclusion.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Schumann - Novelletten, Op. 21
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Novelletten, Op. 21. The eight pieces for piano that make up this song cycle are often performed separately. It bears a dedication to pianist Adolph Henselt.

programme.title: Mozart Symphony No. 34 And Dvorák Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: Beethoven - Quintet for piano and winds, Op. 16
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, Op. 16. The piece, completed in 1796, is assumed to have been modelled on Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in this touching performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 9 in D major. Written in 1908-1909, it was the last symphony Mahler completed. Initially, the superstitious composer, believing in the so-called ‘curse of the ninth,’ did not want to write a Symphony No. 9.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 22
programme.desc: Pianist Mikhail Pletnev is accompanied by the Russian National Orchestra led by Kirill Karabits in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 22. At its premiere in 1868, the orchestra was led by Anton Rubinstein, with the composer himself at the piano. The current concert was recorded at the Moscow Philharmonic Society and opens with a performance of Sergei Prokofiev's symphonic picture 'Dreams'.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 6
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Sol Gabetta at the Lucerne Festival 2018
programme.desc: Argentinian cellist Sol Gabetta returned to the Lucerne Festival to perform Bohuslav Martinu’s Cello Concerto No. 1 (H. 196), followed by Manfred Grafe’s arrangement of ‘Lensky’s Aria from Tchaikovsky’s Eugene Onegin. She is accompanied by the Mahler Chamber Orchestra led by François-Xavier Roth.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Strauss, Beethoven And Schoenberg
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Strauss’ Horn Concerto No. 1. This work is one of the most popular and frequently performed horn concertos written in the 19th century, and the first orchestral piece the composer wrote for the instrument. Strauss’ father, Franz, was a virtuoso horn player, and one of the leading performers of his time.

programme.title: Chopin - Introduction And Polonaise, Op. 3
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven’s loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn’s and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Symphony No. 3, Op. 78
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’ (1835-1921) Symphony No. 3, Op. 78. Geert Bierling stars as soloist on the organ of De Doelen. It was recorded on October 20th, 2018 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. Saint-Saëns Symphony No. 3 was completed in 1886. It is known as the Organ Symphony since the instrument is used in the second and fourth movement of the work.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva’ Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann’s only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls.

programme.title: Music in the air
programme.desc: Television plays a crucial role in popularizing classical music. Not only has it preserved precious moments of music making, but it also helps shape the future of music. The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association for all those involved in any aspect of classical and contemporary music, world music, jazz, and dance, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015.

programme.title: Beethoven - Fidelio, Op. 72
programme.desc: Fidelio (originally titled 'Leonore, oder Der Triumph der ehelichen Liebe,' which translates to 'Leonore, or the Triumph of Marital Love'), Op. 72, is Ludwig van Beethoven's only opera. This 2018 opera film from the Swiss Theater St. Gallen is based on Jan Schmidt-Garre's highly acclaimed stage production of Beethoven's Fidelio. Otto Tausk conducts the Sinfonieorchester and choir of St.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke, Op. 73
programme.desc: In Geneva, the city where she spent the most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play in private chamber music. Between each piece, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit, in an intimate interview that brings both their intimacy and the music.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 6, Op. 18 No. 6
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004.

programme.title: Bach - Preludes and Fugues And Alla variata BWV 989
programme.desc: At the age of eleven, Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti (*1977) debuted with Italian chamber orchestra I Solisti Veneti under the baton of Claudio Scimone. He performed on international festivals and in prestigious concert halls worldwide. Besides, he appeared with several renowned orchestras such as Lucerne Festival Strings, Camerata Salzburg, and Prague Chamber Orchestra. In this recital, Bacchetti performs works of J. S. Bach.

programme.title: Andre Marques - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist, composer, and arranger André Marques.

programme.title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow.

The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Shayna Steele
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: State of Mind
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.desc: S2 E8 — Chile Chiloe, Wood CultureShow me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Exo PlanetsAs scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system. With technological advances and improved techniques scientists are discovering more and more worlds every day.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Edge of the UniverseThe night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe the further back in time we reach. What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Chlorine, Titanium, Gallium, Potassium, NickelThis series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Domino's Pizza, Fortune Cookies, GadgetsIt's cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You'll learn how DOMINICK'S PIZZA became DOMINO'S PIZZA. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn't be complete without fluffy sweet COTTON CANDY! We'll explain how this feathery goodness SPUN to life!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Monopoly, Area Codes, TuxedoTake a trip to the Jersey Shore and learn how one of its famous boardwalks helped to inspire the iconic board game of MONOPOLY. And how did a donkey and an elephant become associated with politics? Plus, what's the difference between TOP GRAIN LEATHER and FULL GRAIN LEATHER?

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Sustainable Water ManagementWater: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Milky Way, Enecladus, Saturn, Tides, Eclipse, Looking Into the PastThis is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: S1 E6What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon?

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Silver, Hydrogen, Phosphorus, Germanium, SulphurThis series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: S1 E4 — TelephonyA man with an ear for music, one of the first to try teaching the deaf how to speak, thought he could build a "harmonic telegraph". He had this idea that several notes could travel through a wire simultaneously, instead of the one Morse code that the telegraph could transmit.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Space Walk, Oort Cloud, Mercury, Space Suit, Star Chart, PlutoThis is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Cities Under SiegeOur cities are being attacked, overrun and overwhelmed with pests and invasive species. What happens if these urban invaders continue to expand their territory? Is it just a matter of time before an emerging deadly disease carried by one of those urban invaders creates havoc in our big cities?

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Road to a Grammy - Los Angeles city of starsMusic Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure... music.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Lafayette: Sounds from the BayouMusic Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure... music.

programme.title: The PAST Hunters
programme.desc: S1 E15 — The Haunted ParadeDerek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: RIP Files
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Hidden SecretsLong-hidden secrets are revealed through the R.I.P. team's talents and unique experiences, including those thought to be lost forever.

programme.title: What in the World
programme.desc: S1 E4 — EthiopiaIndris Seid Yimer and Emyet Assen Woraki's lives have been utterly transformed in the last thirty years. In 1984, they, their families and their community were engulfed in famine and devastation, a famine memorably described by BBC journalist Michael Buerk as "the closest thing to hell on Earth".

programme.title: What in the World
programme.desc: S1 E5 — MexicoPresented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Wild WindsIn this installment, we turn up the heat to examine a natural phenomenon that is both a friend, and a foe to humankind. Some 2 to 400 thousand years ago our ancestors had learned how to create and control fire... a step vital to human development.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: S1 E2 — WhanganuiRV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ - experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The PAST Hunters
programme.desc: S1 E16 — Knutsford Crown Court - Part 1Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: RIP Files
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Echoes of WarThe haunted Graffitti House dates from the Civil War and many of its previous residents still linger.

programme.title: Wild Australia With Ray Mears
programme.desc: S1 E1 — The ReefRay Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.

programme.title: Wild Australia With Ray Mears
programme.desc: S1 E2 — The WetlandsRay Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Chimpanzee Birthday PartyDali the emperor tamarin has an age-old problem. He's going bald. But not on his head - on his back! The Loro Parque keepers have a mystery on their hands but all evidence points to two other mischievous monkeys that are so cute - you'd never suspect a thing!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Aquarium AdventuresWith a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods - you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups - you won't believe what they unearth!

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: S1 E4 — ActivistsGasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: S1 E10 — MenorcaAn oasis of serenity and a Mediterranean paradise with fantastic, untouched beaches, a turquoise sea, white sands and magnificent nature, including a horse trail slash hiking trail stretching around the entire island.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: S2 E18 — A Ghost Town Tour of NevadaOutta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world...

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: S2 E19 — East or West Coast? Catalina and Turks and CaicosOutta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world...

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Dangerous on LandThe mighty grizzly bear. The tiny powerful ant. The lunging inimitable crocodile. The indestructible rhino beetle. The hammering mantis shrimp. Which is the strongest of them all? GRIZZLY BEAR In the rugged beauty of North Americas sub-alpine lands patrols its mightiest resident...

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: S1 E2 — FastestThe explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo... The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse... Or the quick footed pronghorn... Which is the fastest over land?

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Whale Sharks: Gentle GiantsWhale Sharks: Gentle Giants introduces us to this amazing creature through scientists who are racing against time to save the species. Utilizing space-age technology from NASA and the Hubble Telescope, researchers are able to identify, catalogue and track individual sharks.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 30
programme.desc: The main event in this episode sees Andre Berto defend the WBC welterweight championship against Freddy Hernandez. With one quick, hard right hand to the face in the first round, this bout comes to a sudden halt. Berto looks to keep his undefeated streak alive and thrust himself into talks for bigger fights with the likes of stars such as Floyd Mayweather.

programme.title: Prison Fighters T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: This series follows former Muay Thai champion Noy Khaopan and American Cody Moberly, two inmates in a Thailand prison, who after seven years are given the chance to fight for their release. programme.desc: Météo Outremer

programme.title: La Machine à Écrire et autres Sources de Tracas
programme.desc: L’idée de filmer une, puis deux, puis trois « V.A.D. », comme disent les soignants pour « visites à domicile », s’est naturellement imposée : elles permettent d’étoffer certains personnages, de les singulariser. Au-delà, il semble important de montrer que l’Adamant n’est pas une entité repliée sur elle-même, fonctionnant en vase clos, puisque c’est tout le contraire.

programme.title: Présence Protestante
programme.desc: Pour les 100 ans du Palais de la Femme, Écriture. s rend hommage à Blanche Peyron, son opiniâtre fondatrice, officier de l'Armée du Salut. Marion Muller-Colard reçoit Marie-Laure Marshall, auteure de la bande-dessinée Blanche, une victorieuse – Naissance d’une armée contre la misère (Bibli’O) et Laetitia Colombani parle de son livre Les Victorieuses (Grasset).

programme.title: A l'origine Histoires 2026
programme.desc: Frank Lalou est calligraphe, et il est surtout passionné par le sens des lettres. Grâce à son art, il explore la dimension spirituelle et mystique des 22 lettres de l’alphabet hébraïque. Des lettres qui s’enchaînent et sont comme des chemins de vie. Son souffle accompagne chacun de ses gestes comme une inspiration du Souffle Divin.

programme.desc: Présenté par Damien Thévenot 'Mot de passe', le jeu de mots culte de France Télévisions, fait son grand retour en version quotidienne de 32 minutes sur France 3. Chaque jour, deux candidats s’affrontent en compagnie de deux personnalités dans une compétition haletante pour tenter de décrocher 2000 euros. programme.title: Alors on Bouge
programme.desc: Une production France Télévisions Participez à ce rendez-vous sport et bien-être et suivez pas à pas les exercices de nos deux coaches : Sophie Roulaud, professeur de fitness, et Valérie Copin, professeur de yoga. Un duo complémentaire pour allier énergie, renforcement musculaire, souplesse et détente au quotidien.

programme.title: Ici Matin
programme.desc: De 6h30 à 9h, « Ici Matin » est votre premier rendez-vous de la journée avec l’information de proximité. Elle ouvre les matinées 100 % régionales de France 3. Au programme, des journaux d’information en hyper proximité tous les quarts d’heure, des points météo et trafic réguliers, de l’interactivité avec les auditeurs et téléspectateurs, et surtout une grande bouffée de bonne humeur pour démarrer la journée du bon pied !

programme.title: Escales en France
programme.desc: Ce magazine va nous faire découvrir les régions françaises en plongeant le téléspectateur au cœur d'une ville, d'un département français, d'une région, et lui fera découvrir son histoire, ses richesses patrimoniales, ses spécialités gastronomiques et ses lieux incontournables… Escales en France va à la rencontre de ces français agriculteurs, marins pêcheurs, artisans, restaurateurs, éleveurs, guides touristiques, tous amoureux fous...

programme.title: C'est Succulent!
programme.desc: Leila Albert est meilleure mangeuse que cuisinière. Deux bonnes raisons pour notre animatrice de recevoir dans sa cuisine une grand-mère experte en bons petits plats. Ensemble, elles vont cuisiner un plat inspiré des traditions culinaires de sa région. L'invitée en connaît tous les secrets. Un duo intergénérationnel et gourmand à la découverte d'un terroir, de ses producteurs et artisans.

Il s’invite dans leurs cuisines, ouvre leurs placards et leurs frigos. Avec les aliments présents, ils relèvent le défi de concocter un plat de chef.

programme.title: Rachelle allison a la Cigale
programme.desc: Production: BCI Communication - Frédéric Tyrode Saint Louis Réalisation: Arnaud Legoff Rachelle Allison est une artiste guadeloupéenne, originaire de Basse-Terre. Passionnée de musique et de chant depuis son plus jeune âge, ses influences musicales sont diverses : rythm and blues, reggae, dancehall et le rap. Après quelques années dans l’hexagone pour ses études, Rachelle rentre en Guadeloupe pour vivre sa passion.

programme.title: Planète Rap, la Quotidienne
programme.desc: Fred Musa interroge un artiste urbain sur son rapport au rap.

programme.title: Barth à la Cigale
programme.desc: Une production : BCI Communication Réalisation : Arnaud Legoff Capté à la Cigale de Paris le 27 février 2026. Issu d'une famille d'artistes, Barth, de son vrai nom Rudy Ichane Moimbe, baigne très tôt dans la musique, qui devient le socle de son identité. À 8 ans, il intègre le conservatoire de Saint-Benoît, où il se forme à la guitare et pose les premières bases d'un univers déjà singulier.

programme.title: Billie Eilish, sa French Story
programme.desc: Un film de Claire Duguet et Yasmina Jaafri Coécrit avec Michka Assayas Production : Une prod à soi et Slo Slo avec la participation de France Télévisions C’est à Paris que ce film se situe pour raconter le lien fort entre Billie Eilish et la France… Sa French Story ! Nourri de témoignages et d’archives rares de l’artiste à Paris, mais aussi de nombreux extraits de ses vidéoclips, ce film est un voyage original et inédit !

programme.title: Notre Sacre
programme.desc: Le Sacre du printemps de Stravinski est une partition phare de la modernité, une œuvre clé dans son retentissement artistique, que ce soit chez les musiciens ou chez les chorégraphes. 111 ans après sa création mémorable, Blanca Li, Abd al Malik et David Grimal en proposent une nouvelle relecture, qui met l’accent sur son universalité et son actualité. En 1913, déjà, Le Sacre du printemps faisait œuvre de pleine conscience.

programme.desc: S3 E3 — Segredos dos ImortaisÁguas sagradas com poderes curativos. Místicos ancestrais que viveram séculos. Uma descoberta científica poderá fornecer as respostas para a vida eterna. Ao longo da História, muitos foram os que procuraram o segredo para a imortalidade, até agora, sem sucesso.

programme.title: O Inexplicável: Mistérios do Universo
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Estaremos Sozinhos?Objetos não identificados observados por pilotos militares, sondas extraterrestres que atravessam o nossos Sistema Solar, e um potencial mundo extraterrestre na escuridão do Espaço. Poderá a recente sequência de estranhos encontros aproximar-nos das respostas para as perguntas milenares?

programme.title: O Inexplicável: Mistérios do Universo
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Terráqueos ExtraterrestresNuma altura em que se fazem planos para irmos além da Lua, a novos mundos, como estamos a preparar-nos para sermos extraterrestres humanos? Como vamos sobreviver a essa viagem ao desconhecido? Conseguiremos viver no nosso próximo destino galáctico? E o que faremos se encontrarmos vida inteligente?

programme.title: Mistérios Revelados Com Danny Trejo
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Segredos MilitaresAs descobertas de segredos militares podem não envolver espiões, satélites e mensagens encriptadas. De lenhadores a trabalhadores da construção civil, nunca se sabe quem vai desvendar informações ultrassecretas. Este episódio traz-nos formas surpreendentes na exposição de segredos militares.

programme.title: Mistérios Revelados Com Danny Trejo
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Descobertas SagradasÉ frequente relíquias religiosas e culturais andarem perdidas durante séculos. Quando são descobertas, podem mudar o mundo como o conhecemos. Trazemos-lhe textos ancestrais que põem em causa o que julgamos saber sobre a História da Religião, outros que confirmam aquilo em que sempre acreditámos.

programme.title: Mistérios Revelados Com Danny Trejo
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Achados LetaisPor vezes, as descobertas acidentais podem matar, de um segredo mortífero num parque nacional, a uma bomba-relógio num quintal, passando até por uma lendária maldição que pode mesmo ser real. Em terra, no mar e até no Espaço, exploramos o baú dos achados fortuitos mais letais do mundo.

programme.title: Special Investigations
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Círculos Nas SearasHá mais de meio século que, todos os anos, surgem gigantescos vestígios misteriosos nos campos de cultivo ingleses perto do mítico marco de Stonehenge. Esses círculos nas searas aparecem da noite para o dia e medem dezenas de metros.

programme.title: Special Investigations
programme.desc: S1 E4 — RoswellA 8 de julho de 1947, a primeira página do 'Roswell Record' anunciou orgulhosamente a captura de um disco voador identificado num rancho próximo. No dia seguinte, a mesma publicação desmentiu e assegurou ao público que a Força Aérea não tinha recuperado um disco voador.

programme.title: Special Investigations
programme.desc: S1 E5 — O Caso ItalianoNas últimas três décadas, houve vários casos de encontros imediatos em Itália. O primeiro foi o de Antonio Urzi, o mais destacado caçador de ÓVNI da Europa, que tem registado algumas das imagens mais impressionantes nos céus de Milão.

programme.title: Special Investigations
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Cidades MilenaresJaime visita três das mais importantes cidades da América Latina em termos da sua ligação ao fenómeno dos ÓVNI. Começa por Teotihuacán, no México. Os peritos debatem sobre o significado das pirâmides do sol e da lua, e quem as construiu, e revelam descobertas que podem associar Teotihuacán a Marte.

programme.title: Vikings, Novos Factos
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Nasce um SonhoNa Noruega, arqueólogos, peritos medievais e construtores de barcos reuniram-se para explorar os segredos encontrados nos vestígios de navios centenários e nos textos de ancestrais sagas escandinavas. O seu objetivo? Projetar e construir a maior réplica de um navio víquingue alguma vez imaginada.

programme.title: Vikings, Novos Factos
programme.desc: S1 E2 — A Prova das ProvasEm Haugesund, na Noruega, a réplica do navio víquingue 'Draken' está concluída, e o seu proprietário multimilionário já elegeu um comandante para liderar a tripulação nos seus longos testes marítimos, em preparação para uma odisseia transatlântica.

programme.title: Forjado No Fogo
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Catana JaponesaEm três rondas extenuantes, os concorrentes desenham e forjam armas de guerra letais. Na ronda final, dois cuteleiros terão de forjar uma das armas mais simbólicas da História: a catana japonesa. As espadas serão testadas até ao limite e o teste determinará se a catana é mais forte do que uma bala.

programme.title: Forjado No Fogo
programme.desc: S10 E5 — Na Estrada: Campeão AmericanoNeste episódio especial, voltamos à nossa forja, onde quatro dos melhores cuteleiros dos EUA se defrontarão na batalha final. Depois de três provas duríssimas, qual deles sairá vencedor, tornando-se o primeiro campeão do 'Forjado no Fogo' na estrada?

programme.title: Forjado No Fogo
programme.desc: S10 E9 — Vencer os Invictos: Mestres do MistérioNeste desafio especial, dois campeões de 'Forjado no Fogo' defrontam-se numa ronda de cinco horas para criarem as suas lâminas 'san mai', pela oportunidade de competir contra um dos nossos titãs. Enfrentarão o 'Gladiador da Forja' Jesse Hu, o supercampeão Collin Sage ou o juiz invicto Ben Abbott.

programme.title: Os Maiores Mistérios da História
programme.desc: S3 E9 — O Manuscrito de VoynichTalvez seja o livro mais misterioso do mundo, um manuscrito medieval repleto de desenhos não identificáveis, escrito numa língua secreta tão complexa que nem os melhores descodificadores do mundo conseguem decifrá-la. O que é o Manuscrito de Voynich, e quem o escreveu?

programme.title: Os Maiores Mistérios da História
programme.desc: S5 E1 — O Tesouro Perdido de MontezumaO tesouro de um rei asteca desaparece sem deixar rasto, dando origem a uma busca de 500 anos em vários continentes. Um dos maiores guerreiros de todos os tempos juntou uma grande riqueza, que se crê valer atualmente mais de três mil milhões de dólares. Mas o seu paradeiro permanece um mistério.

programme.title: Os Maiores Mistérios da História
programme.desc: S5 E8 — O Mistério de Machu PicchuCom segredos com 500 anos, pedras e esqueletos escondidos, Machu Picchu é um dos sítios arqueológicos mais intrigantes do planeta. Conta-se entre os grandes enigmas do Mundo Antigo. Quem construiu este espantoso complexo, e por quê?

programme.title: Os Maiores Mistérios da História
programme.desc: S6 E6 — A Morte e a Fortuna de Pablo EscobarPablo Escobar, o famigerado narcotraficante que, nos anos 80, fornecia a maior parte da cocaína aos EUA, tinha milhares de milhões em dinheiro vivo. Crê-se que quando foi alvejado, em 1993, valeria o equivalente a mais de 50 mil milhões de dólares atuais. Quem matou Pablo Escobar?

programme.title: Os Maiores Mistérios da História
programme.desc: S6 E7 — O Espólio Perdido de Jesse JamesDinheiro, joias e dois milhões de dólares em barras de ouro... Jesse James e o seu bando assaltavam comboios, diligências e bancos, e enterravam todo o produto. Mas só uma fração dos milhões foi encontrada. Se James e o seu bando esconderam uma fortuna, onde poderá ela estar?

programme.desc: S1 E1 — Murder For SaleQuando Beverly Carter, uma agente imobiliária de sucesso, desaparece depois de uma reunião com um cliente, a Polícia tem de apurar se alguém teria motivos para a magoar.

programme.title: Home Sweet Homicide
programme.desc: S1 E2 — The DC Mansion MurdersNum dos mais exclusivos bairros de Washington, DC, A Polícia depara-se uma cena de crime aterradora nas ruínas queimadas de uma mansão.

programme.title: Nightmare Next Door
programme.desc: S6 E1 — Criss-Cross MurdersQuando o corpo de Veronica Bozza é encontrado na sala de sua casa, a comunidade fica chocada e uma situação bizarra acaba por ser exposta.

programme.title: Nightmare Next Door
programme.desc: S6 E3 — The Unwelcome WagonQuando Michael Severance desaparece, a comunidade de San Angelo reúne-se em torno da noiva dele. Mas há algo de sinistro no desaparecimento de Michael.

programme.title: Border Control: Europe
programme.desc: S1 E19 — Episode 19Os serviços de segurança e aduaneiros nas fronteiras dos países europeus são alvo de ameaça constante de drogas, armas e terroristas. A sua função é detetar situações perigosas.

programme.title: Controlo de Fronteiras: Polónia
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Episode 1Em Dorohusk, agentes aduaneiros revistam um comboio conhecido por transportar mercadoria de contrabando. A inspeção por raios X e revista a um camião deixa um condutor assustado.

programme.title: Calls from the Inside

programme.title: Calls from the Inside

programme.desc: S1 E6 — A Monster's Game PlanUm assalto a uma loja acaba num sequestro e o Ranger do Texas Jim Holland segue um suspeito até a um motel, para localizar o dono desaparecido.

programme.desc: Lana appartient à la lignée légendaire des Longuebarbe, célèbres meneurs de quêtes à travers les Dix Royaumes. Mais Lana a grandi à l’écart de l’aventure, sur l’île de Shediac, pendant que son père Andar parcourait les mers à bord de son navire légendaire. Quand l’invitation tarde à arriver, Lana décide de s’inviter à bord du bateau !
